headline: Boom/bust player projections
method_note: Week 1 pregame player priors rebuilt from the anytime-TD market board universe. QB passing-yards spec selected on 2024 validation and locked-tested on 2025; QB rushing touchdowns allocated by a QB-only model with red-zone/goal-line carry shares. No betting edge is claimed.

qb_model.spec: combined_rush (rolling 3/6-game passing volume, air yards, EPA, CPOE, rushing) trained 2023-25, point-in-time features
qb_model.market_gap_note: The retired v1.1.0 -16.95 yd median gap was measured against FanDuel lines, not actuals. On the locked 2025 test this spec is approximately unbiased vs actuals; model-vs-market gaps are descriptive only.

bust_model.definition: Under 30 receiving yards AND under 50% of prior six-game mean among players averaging at least 4 targets per game

cfb_status: CFB receiving projections withheld: 2024 target-player fields were materially incomplete versus 2025 and have not been repaired to a consistent source yet.

sportsbook.label: Research only
sportsbook.note: Current Week 1 lines are maintained by the audited FanDuel capture pipeline. Model-minus-book differences remain suppressed until prospective evaluation clears the registered gate.

qb_starter_status.source_updated_note: Team charts on source showed updates through September 1, 2026.
qb_starter_status.policy: Default QB view shows only model-covered QBs listed first on the current depth chart. Backups remain available behind a toggle. 2025 production and 2026 preseason inform projections, not starter designation.

ranking_policy.default: Current depth-chart role first, then 2025 fantasy production within position. Boom probability remains an optional sort, not the default.

projection_freeze.leakage_control: All numeric projections use point-in-time trailing nflverse features through the 2025 season and were frozen before the first 2026 Week 1 kickoff. No book lines enter the model. Replaces defective v1.1.0 priors before any Week 1 game started.
